subject.title: fix(gateway): stop accepting the Control UI token via ?token= query string

question: Should OpenClaw remove shipped assistant-media `?token=` authentication now, or require a transition path for older links and custom clients first?
rationale: The code change is a clean security hardening, but current main and the latest release still accept this auth fallback, so merge changes upgrade behavior for existing users outside what automated review can decide.

options.title: Accept secure fail-closed removal
options.body: Land the PR as-is and make `Authorization: Bearer` plus scoped mediaTicket URLs the only supported assistant-media credential paths.

options.title: Require a transition path
options.body: Ask for a documented deprecation window, explicit opt-in compatibility mode, or migration guidance before removing shipped query-token auth.

options.title: Pause for broader media-auth policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers settle how it should coordinate with the adjacent Tailscale media-auth issue and broad Control UI hardening PR.

recommendation.title: Accept secure fail-closed removal
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is and make `Authorization: Bearer` plus scoped mediaTicket URLs the only supported assistant-media credential paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the scoped mediaTicket replacement path and Control UI media-auth contract that steipete recently implemented.
